coverage: Audited company results · two reported segments
definition: Reported earnings for each part of the company before tax and before costs or income the company does not assign to either group.
location: May 18 NSE filing, annual financial results and separate segment table, audited year ended March 31, 2026; note 4 on employee benefit expense.
notes: The combined result of ₹152.94 crore less ₹7.70 crore of shared costs plus ₹4.95 crore of shared income gives ₹150.19 crore before tax. Company profit after tax was ₹103.58 crore. It includes an estimated ₹0.81 crore one-time expense for retirement and paid-leave benefits under the Labour Codes.
insight: Vehicle parts brought in more revenue and reported earnings than the industrial group, which includes backup generator controls.
